description: Edition changed deliberately on 2026-09-25 at the user's request: trunk and limb sites now stage on the UICC TNM 9th edition (UICC recommends it from 1 January 2026; T, N, M and the stage groups are those of the 8th), so "UICC 8th edition" now reads "UICC 9th edition" in the pTNM heading and the diagnosis line. report:
Skin, left thigh, wide local excision and lymphadenectomy

Received in formalin is an ellipse of skin measuring 6.5 x 3.5 x 1.5 cm bearing an ulcerated nodule measuring 3.5 cm. A suture marks 12 o'clock, taken as superior. The lesion is 4 mm from the closest skin edge. The deep surface is inked. The ellipse is serially sliced and all embedded in 5 blocks.

(1) Tip A. (2-4) Lesion, cross-sections. (5) Tip B.

Specimen and tumour
- Procedure: Wide local excision and lymphadenectomy
- Tumour site: Left thigh
- Tumour size: 35 mm (greatest dimension)

Microscopic findings
- Histologic type: Squamous cell carcinoma, not otherwise specified
- Histologic grade: G2, moderately differentiated
- Tumour histology:
  The tumour is a moderately differentiated squamous cell carcinoma, invading the reticular dermis to a depth of 4 mm. It is composed of irregular nests of keratinocytes with moderate nuclear pleomorphism and frequent mitoses, keratinisation being limited to scattered keratin pearls and individually keratinised cells.
- Depth of invasion: 4 mm
- Anatomic level: IV (carcinoma invades reticular dermis)
- Lymphovascular invasion: Not identified
- Perineural invasion: Not identified

Margins
- Invasive tumour: All margins negative
  - Closest peripheral margin: 4 mm (superior)
  - Deep margin: 3 mm

Lymph nodes
- Regional lymph nodes: 9 examined; 1 involved
  - Laterality: Ipsilateral (including midline)
  - Extranodal extension: Not identified
  - Size of largest metastatic deposit: 35 mm, inguinal

Pathological stage (UICC 9th edition)
- pTNM: pT2 pN2

BWH tumour classification
- BWH class: T2a: 1 high-risk factor
  - High-risk factors: Tumour diameter 2 cm or more

Additional findings
- None identified

SKIN, left thigh, wide local excision and lymphadenectomy
- SQUAMOUS CELL CARCINOMA, moderately differentiated, 35 mm, invading the
  reticular dermis to a depth of 4 mm; completely excised (closest peripheral
  margin 4 mm, superior; deep margin 3 mm); see synoptic report
- 1 of 9 regional lymph nodes involved
- pT2 pN2 (UICC 9th edition); BWH T2a
